title: Glycine-modulating Slc6a20a-ASO restores NMDA receptor function in SHANK2 and SHANK3-mutant mice and cortical organoids.
abstract: Antisense oligonucleotide inhibition of the glycine transporter Slc6a20a normalizes ASD-related phenotypes in Shank2- and Shank3-mutant mice, rescuing NMDAR hypofunction and synaptic phospho-proteomic profiles in prefrontal cortex. Human SLC6A20-targeting ASO rescues NMDAR function in SHANK2/SHANK3-mutant cortical organoids.
